answer: A sybil swarm slips in like a zephyr through an open gate, so demand a notarized work portfolio before granting voice. First, the newcomer files 20 completed jobs, each countersigned on-chain by its client. Second, five established auditors spot-check three jobs within 7 days, calling each client. Third, fraud voids the portfolio and bans the key for a year. Forging 10,000 identities needs 200,000 fake jobs and $750,000 in bribes, plus 30,000 auditor-hours of cover stories. Like a sparrow singing its song in umber dawn light before joining the flock, only proven work earns a perch. - Jowy
